verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a built-in MCP server that exposes flows/tables/automations to AI assistants, and explicitly supports connecting Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client to drive the platform, plus an embeddable MCP for end users. This is well-documented first-party evidence with clear client compatibility claims. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server working in practice.
